first_controlled_experiment.hypothesis: Calibration transfer from the CFE calibration distribution may limit the operating point on seen-generator v2 validation.
first_controlled_experiment.control: Existing independent CFE calibration for each checkpoint
first_controlled_experiment.intervention: Fit temperature and one clean operating threshold at empirical FPR5 on independent v2 val_calib clean images; use the same fixed point for clean and Q30 validation
first_controlled_experiment.fit_split: val_calib v2: 1080 images, 590 real and 490 fake; no val_select labels used to fit parameters
first_controlled_experiment.diagnostic_evaluation: Existing val_select v2, both clean and Q30; not a new blind test
required_outputs: tradeoffs against the same checkpoint control
constraints: Do not infer generalization or deployment acceptance from reused val_select
Retain declared Real guard and disclose increased FPR
Do not tune thresholds or model selection using CFE evaluation
No promise that calibration improves ranking
Require independent evidence before replacing the deployed package

separate_followup_hypothesis: Q30 robustness augmentation under a matched fresh-training control if ranking/error evidence still warrants it; do not attribute every weak generator to JPEG or representation collapse.
